title: Lucy Powell elected Labour’s new deputy leader – UK politics live
summary: Polling had suggested Lucy Powell enjoyed a healthy lead over Bridget Phillipson as voting closed on Thursday Home secretary Shabana Mahmood , the chair of Labour’s National Executive Committee , has announced the results of the Labour deputy leader contest, naming Lucy Powell as the winner. Powell received 87,407 votes, while Bridget Phillipson got 73,536 votes. The turnout was 16.6% . Continue reading...

title: Lucy Powell wins Labour deputy leadership election
summary: MP for Manchester Central had been seen as favourite ahead of rival Bridget Phillipson throughout contest • UK politics live – latest updates Lucy Powell has won Labour’s deputy leadership election, beating her rival Bridget Phillipson. Powell, who was the Commons leader until she was sacked in Keir Starmer’s reshuffle at the start of September, was seen as the favourite throughout the contest. Continue reading...
